newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT-Cocoa builds for a test of key 1,200 stg.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-Cocoa builds for a test of key 1,200 stg.

text.p: JULY Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA30

LIFFE cocoa futures, backed with encouraging chart prospects, could march towards the initial key resistance at 1,050 stg basis July as it builds a base for the ultimate test of 1,200, technical analysts said on Friday.
Traders called the market to open 10 stg higher.
Trevor Neil, senior technical analyst at Union CAL Futures, said the cocoa charts were increasingly looking constructive.
The five-day relative strength indicator has developed a very good uptrend.
"Today's action should take us to the important level of 1,050. A break of that would indicate a sizeable move higher," he said, adding that it would break the consolidation pattern seen since March.
"That pattern would be broken by a close above 1,050 and cocoa will then have a target of 1,200," he said. -- Jalil Hamid, London newsroom +44 171 542 4985
